prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity north-star composition for a native Windows 11 WinUI 3 desktop application
Primary request: Design composition option C for Codex Tweaks using Microsoft PowerToys settings as the quality bar, entirely in the current Windows 11 Fluent visual language. Show the real “功能包” page with a standard left NavigationView over Mica, transparent Page, a normal Windows page title, a compact action row, a native Developer Mode ToggleSwitch, and environment status. Instead of a table, represent the single real ct-sample package as one broad expandable settings group: its header contains native package glyph, name/version, status and enable toggle; expanded content uses standard settings rows for priority, source path, status detail, Open Directory, and Build. Preserve clear separation between page-level actions and package-level actions. Use native InfoBar for problems and native Button/TextBox/ToggleSwitch styling.
Composition/framing: landscape Windows desktop app window, 3:2 viewport, entire first viewport. Medium density between the spacious Settings option and the compact Store catalog option.
Text (verbatim, use only these real product strings): “Codex Tweaks”, “概览”, “功能包”, “运行日志”, “关于与更新”, “按包管理页面增强”, “重新扫描”, “安装本地包”, “从 Git 安装”, “检查远程更新”, “开发者模式”, “优先级”, “打开目录”, “编译”, “ct-sample”, “1.0.0”, “codex_tweaks 示例”, “尚未编译”, “Node.js 可用”, “Git 可用”. Other secondary copy should be quiet gray placeholder lines, never invented claims.
Color palette: Windows 11 system light theme, pale Mica, white/near-white content layer, system accent blue, semantic status colors used only when meaningful.
Constraints: exactly one package, no invented metrics, no spinner/NumberBox, unmistakably native WinUI 3, Segoe UI Variable, Fluent icons, realistic control sizing, accessible contrast, no watermark.
Avoid: web dashboard, data table, bento grid, nested cards, giant hero, neon terminal, gradients, glossy glass, custom typography, emoji, non-Windows controls.
